subject.title: fix(agent): recover disconnected gateway runs before rerunning

question: After an accepted Gateway run disconnects and recovery cannot establish a terminal outcome, should `openclaw agent` automatically use the existing isolated embedded fallback or fail closed unless the user explicitly opts into a rerun?
rationale: This choice changes established CLI behavior, user-visible latency, side-effect risk, stdout results, and `--deliver` semantics; it cannot be safely selected by patch review alone.

options.title: Recovery first, then isolated fallback
options.body: Wait and cache-replay the accepted Gateway run first, then retain automatic `gateway-fallback-*` execution only after the defined recovery deadline expires.

options.title: Recovery first, then fail closed
options.body: Return the unresolved run identifier and require an explicit rerun action so users never receive an automatic second execution after ambiguity.

options.title: Keep immediate isolated fallback
options.body: Retain current main behavior and pause or substantially narrow this PR if the changed interactive recovery contract is not desired.

recommendation.title: Recovery first, then isolated fallback
recommendation.body: Wait and cache-replay the accepted Gateway run first, then retain automatic `gateway-fallback-*` execution only after the defined recovery deadline expires.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged fallback containment behavior whose successor policy this PR proposes to change.
